text:
alex: Heads-up - PR #14567 is blocked by the CI matrix. windows/arm64 shard failed on a snapshot/assertion. Need eyes when you have a minute.

ci-bot: [matrix build] https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7421 - windows-arm64 failed (test failure) :x:

jamie: I can look. Which test?

alex: The failure is in `tests::integration::file_lock_windows` - flaked with a timeout while waiting on a file handle. Error snippet:

```
thread 'tests::integration::file_lock_windows' panicked at 'assertion failed: expected file lock acquired', /workspace/tests/fs/lock.rs:87
Caused by: OS error 121: operation timed out
```

nina: That looks nondeterministic. Any recent changes to the file locking code or test harness in this PR?

alex: PR only touches routing meta, nothing with file code. Failing shard is windows-arm64 only (windows-x86 and linux-green). Could be infra or a flaky test.

jamie: Can we do a targeted rerun on that shard first? If it's infra, rerun should pass. If it consistently fails, we'll bisect.

ops-oncall: +1 for targeted rerun. I'll kick it off in a bit. If it reproduces, we should collect a debug dump.

alex: Thanks. Also FYI the snapshot diff is subtle (timing-based) so I don't think `snapshot update` is the right move.

ci-bot: Triggered targeted rerun for build 7421: windows-arm64 (requested by ops-oncall). Status: queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jamie: If rerun passes, can someone approve merge? I'm fine to approve after a green rerun.

nina: If it flakes again, we should add a retry wrapper to the test and open a follow-up issue to investigate root cause. I can file it.

ci-bot: Rerun completed: windows-arm64 - green :white_check_mark: (build 7421-rerun-1). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7421/rerun/1

alex: Nice, thanks ops-oncall. Since rerun is green I'm going to merge once jamie approves. No snapshot updates required.

jamie: Approved and merged. :shipit:

nina: Filing tracking issue for flaky file-lock test (assigning to infra + windows eng).

alex: Closing thread. Thanks everyone. :heart:
